issue_context.title: build should exit if icons not found
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
If the icons can't be found (as described in `src-tauri/Cargo.toml` then the build should fail and explain why it failed.
comments: Some weird behavior with the bundler and how it handles mangled directories. Its something that I will need to look into further.  As it is now, if the cargo.toml doesn't have anything in the icon key and/or the icons folder is empty then the bundler fails to compile.

review_comments: This hardcodes the `icons/icon.ico` location. We are specifying its location in the `src-tauri/Cargo.toml` file.

I know, I am working on that.  For the windows example, I am going to leave the hardcode.  Making the build read through the cargo.toml is just asking for trouble and the dev can always go through and change the hardcode themselves.
Not that function but yes, in the bundler is where this will go.
